children: Saab said it signed preliminary collaboration deals with space companies SSC Space and OHB, as well as telecommunications-gear maker Ericsson, to expand into the space segment.

The Swedish defense company said Thursday that it aims to take a broader role in space, which is becoming an increasingly important strategic, operational, and tactical domain in the industry. The company said it is looking to act as a system integrator across the space value chain.

"Our recently signed [memorandums of understanding] with SSC Space, OHB Sweden and Ericsson are important steps in that direction and reflect our ambition to take a broader role as a system integrator in the space domain," Saab's strategy and technology head Marcus Wandt said.

Saab said it entered into agreements with Swedish companies SSC Space and Ericsson, and the Swedish business of German satellite maker OHB, to explore how their capabilities can be combined and integrated to support multi-domain operations from space.

title: Saab Sets Sights on Space With Three Collaboration Deals
